description: Build Performance + Test Coverage — measure and improve Gradle build speed, then add unit/integration tests for the highest-risk flows

userStories.title: Measure and document build performance baseline
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to know which Gradle tasks are slowest so I can prioritize optimization effort.
acceptanceCriteria: Run a clean build with --profile flag: `./gradlew assembleDebug --profile --no-daemon`
Identify the top 5 slowest tasks by duration from the HTML report
Document findings in `tasks/build-performance-notes.md` with task names and durations
Note which tasks are configuration-phase vs execution-phase
Run `./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --dry-run` and document the task graph in the same notes file
Typecheck passes (`./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Tune Gradle JVM and parallel execution settings
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Gradle to use available CPU cores and an appropriate heap so builds don't bottleneck on resources.
acceptanceCriteria: `org.gradle.parallel=true` confirmed set in `gradle.properties`
`org.gradle.daemon=true` confirmed set in `gradle.properties`
`org.gradle.jvmargs` heap reviewed — set to at least `-Xmx3g` if not already
Build passes (`./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Enable Gradle configuration cache and build cache
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Gradle to cache configuration and task outputs so repeated builds are faster.
acceptanceCriteria: `org.gradle.configuration-cache=warn` added to `gradle.properties` (warn mode to avoid hard failures from incompatible plugins)
`org.gradle.caching=true` added to `gradle.properties`
Clean build succeeds, followed by a second incremental build
No existing tasks broken by cache enablement
Build passes (`./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Document before/after build timing comparison
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a documented record of build time improvements so I know whether the changes had measurable effect.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `./gradlew assembleDebug --profile --no-daemon` after all config changes
Append before/after timing comparison to `tasks/build-performance-notes.md`
Note any remaining bottlenecks or follow-up opportunities
Typecheck passes (`./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Add unit tests for workout creation and editing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests for the workout creation and editing flows so regressions are caught before they reach the device.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover: creating a new workout session, adding a set to an existing session, editing set values (weight, reps, modifier)
Tests exercise the ViewModel or use-case layer, not just data models
Tests use fakes or in-memory Room database — no mocks of the Room DAO directly
Tests pass (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon`)
Typecheck passes (`./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Add unit tests for movement history and progress behavior
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests for movement history aggregation so changes to progress calculation are caught early.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover: retrieving movement history for a given exercise, computing best set per session, ordering sessions by date
Tests use an in-memory Room database populated with known fixture data
Edge cases covered: no sessions, single session, sessions with multiple sets
Tests pass (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon`)
Typecheck passes (`./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Add unit tests for AI scan parsing flows
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests for the AI scan parsing logic so changes to prompt output handling don't silently break import.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover: parsing a well-formed AI response into workout data, handling a malformed/partial response gracefully, handling an empty response
Tests are pure unit tests — no network calls, use hardcoded JSON/text fixtures
Tests pass (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon`)
Typecheck passes (`./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --no-daemon`)

userStories.title: Add integration tests for fragile UI state logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integration-level tests for the most fragile UI state flows so state bugs are caught before manual testing.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover at minimum: the workouts list screen loading state, the set-editor showing correct initial values when editing an existing set
Tests use Compose testing APIs (not Espresso unless unavoidable)
Tests placed in appropriate `src/test/` or `src/androidTest/` directory
Tests pass
Typecheck passes (`./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --no-daemon`)
